verses.original: וַיַּ֨עַל מֹשֶׁ֜ה מֵֽעַרְבֹ֤ת מוֹאָב֙ אֶל־ הַ֣ר נְב֔וֹ רֹ֚אשׁ הַפִּסְגָּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ פְּנֵ֣י יְרֵח֑וֹ וַיַּרְאֵ֨הוּ יְהוָ֧ה אֶת־ כָּל־ הָאָ֛רֶץ אֶת־ הַגִּלְעָ֖ד עַד־ דָּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘al mō·šeh mê·‘ar·ḇōṯ mō·w·’āḇ ’el- har nə·ḇōw rōš hap·pis·gāh ’ă·šer ‘al- pə·nê yə·rê·ḥōw way·yar·’ê·hū Yah·weh ’eṯ- kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ ’eṯ- hag·gil·‘āḏ ‘aḏ- dān
verses.literal: Then Moses went up from the plains of Moab to Mount Nebo to the top of Pisgah which faces . . . Jericho And the LORD showed him the whole land from Gilead as far as Dan
verses.literalPt: ENTÃO subiu Moisés das campinas de Moabe ao monte Nebo, ao cume de Pisga, que está em frente a Jericó e o SENHOR mostrou-lhe toda a terra desde Gileade até Dã;

verses.original: וְאֵת֙ כָּל־ נַפְתָּלִ֔י וְאֶת־ אֶ֥רֶץ אֶפְרַ֖יִם וּמְנַשֶּׁ֑ה וְאֵת֙ כָּל־ אֶ֣רֶץ יְהוּדָ֔ה עַ֖ד הַיָּ֥ם הָאַחֲרֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êṯ kāl- nap̄·tā·lî wə·’eṯ- ’e·reṣ ’ep̄·ra·yim ū·mə·naš·šeh wə·’êṯ kāl- ’e·reṣ yə·hū·ḏāh ‘aḏ hay·yām hā·’a·ḥă·rō·wn
verses.literal: all of Naphtali the land of Ephraim and Manasseh all the land of Judah as far as the Western Sea
verses.literalPt: E todo Naftali, e a terra de Efraim, e Manassés e toda a terra de Judá, até ao mar ocidental;

verses.original: וְאֶת־ הַנֶּ֗גֶב וְֽאֶת־ הַכִּכָּ֞ר בִּקְעַ֧ת יְרֵח֛וֹ עִ֥יר הַתְּמָרִ֖ים עַד־ צֹֽעַר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- han·ne·ḡeḇ wə·’eṯ- hak·kik·kār biq·‘aṯ yə·rê·ḥōw ‘îr hat·tə·mā·rîm ‘aḏ- ṣō·‘ar
verses.literal: the Negev and the region from the Valley of Jericho the City of Palms all the way to Zoar
verses.literalPt: E o sul, e a campina do vale de Jericó, a cidade das palmeiras, até Zoar.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֵלָ֗יו זֹ֤את הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִ֠שְׁבַּעְתִּי לְאַבְרָהָ֨ם לְיִצְחָ֤ק וּֽלְיַעֲקֹב֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר לְזַרְעֲךָ֖ אֶתְּנֶ֑נָּה הֶרְאִיתִ֣יךָ בְעֵינֶ֔יךָ וְשָׁ֖מָּה לֹ֥א תַעֲבֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’ê·lāw zōṯ hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer niš·ba‘·tî lə·’aḇ·rā·hām lə·yiṣ·ḥāq ū·lə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ lê·mōr lə·zar·‘ă·ḵā ’et·tə·nen·nāh her·’î·ṯî·ḵā ḇə·‘ê·ne·ḵā wə·šām·māh lō ṯa·‘ă·ḇōr
verses.literal: And the LORD said to him This is the land that I swore to give Abraham Isaac and Jacob when I said I will give it to your descendants I have let you see it with your own eyes . . . but you will not cross into it
verses.literalPt: E disse-lhe o SENHOR: Esta é a terra que jurei a Abraão, Isaque, e Jacó, dizendo: À tua descendência a darei; eu te faço vê-la com os teus olhos, porém lá não passarás.

verses.original: וַיָּ֨מָת שָׁ֜ם מֹשֶׁ֧ה עֶֽבֶד־ יְהוָ֛ה בְּאֶ֥רֶץ מוֹאָ֖ב עַל־ פִּ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·māṯ šām mō·šeh ‘e·ḇeḏ- Yah·weh bə·’e·reṣ mō·w·’āḇ ‘al- pî Yah·weh
verses.literal: So Moses the servant of the LORD died there in the land of Moab as the LORD had said
verses.literalPt: Assim morreu ali Moisés, servo do SENHOR, na terra de Moabe, conforme a palavra do SENHOR.

verses.original: וַיִּקְבֹּ֨ר אֹת֤וֹ בַגַּיְ֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מוֹאָ֔ב מ֖וּל בֵּ֣ית פְּע֑וֹר וְלֹֽא־ יָדַ֥ע אִישׁ֙ אֶת־ קְבֻ֣רָת֔וֹ עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·bōr ’ō·ṯōw ḇag·gay bə·’e·reṣ mō·w·’āḇ mūl bêṯ pə·‘ō·wr wə·lō- yā·ḏa‘ ’îš ’eṯ- qə·ḇu·rā·ṯōw ‘aḏ hay·yō·wm haz·zeh
verses.literal: And He buried him in a valley in the land of Moab facing Beth-peor and no one to this day knows the location of his grave
verses.literalPt: E o sepultou num vale, na terra de Moabe, em frente de Bete-Peor; e ninguém soube até hoje o lugar da sua sepultura.

verses.original: וּמֹשֶׁ֗ה בֶּן־ מֵאָ֧ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֛ים שָׁנָ֖ה בְּמֹת֑וֹ לֹֽא־ כָהֲתָ֥ה עֵינ֖וֹ וְלֹא־ נָ֥ס לֵחֹֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mō·šeh ben- mê·’āh wə·‘eś·rîm šā·nāh bə·mō·ṯōw lō- ḵā·hă·ṯāh ‘ê·nōw wə·lō- nās lê·ḥōh
verses.literal: Moses was a hundred and twenty years old . . . when he died yet his eyes were not weak and his vitality had not diminished
verses.literalPt: Era Moisés da idade de cento e vinte anos quando morreu; os seus olhos nunca se escureceram, nem perdeu o seu vigor.

verses.original: וַיִּבְכּוּ֩ בְנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֧ל אֶת־ מֹשֶׁ֛ה בְּעַֽרְבֹ֥ת מוֹאָ֖ב שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים י֑וֹם וַֽיִּתְּמ֔וּ יְמֵ֥י בְכִ֖י אֵ֥בֶל מֹשֶֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiḇ·kū ḇə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ’eṯ- mō·šeh bə·‘ar·ḇōṯ mō·w·’āḇ šə·lō·šîm yō·wm way·yit·tə·mū yə·mê ḇə·ḵî ’ê·ḇel mō·šeh
verses.literal: The Israelites . . . grieved for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days until the time of weeping and mourning for Moses came to an end
verses.literalPt: E os filhos de Israel prantearam a Moisés trinta dias, nas campinas de Moabe; e os dias do pranto no luto de Moisés se cumpriram.

verses.original: וִֽיהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ בִּן־ נ֗וּן מָלֵא֙ ר֣וּחַ חָכְמָ֔ה כִּֽי־ סָמַ֥ךְ מֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶת־ יָדָ֖יו עָלָ֑יו וַיִּשְׁמְע֨וּ אֵלָ֤יו בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֔וּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: wî·hō·wō·šu·a‘ bin- nūn mā·lê rū·aḥ ḥāḵ·māh kî- sā·maḵ mō·šeh ’eṯ- yā·ḏāw ‘ā·lāw way·yiš·mə·‘ū ’ê·lāw bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl way·ya·‘ă·śū ka·’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh ’eṯ- mō·šeh
verses.literal: Now Joshua son of Nun was filled with the spirit of wisdom because Moses had laid his hands on him So the Israelites . . . obeyed him and did as the LORD had commanded Moses
verses.literalPt: E Josué, filho de Num, foi cheio do espírito de sabedoria, porquanto Moisés tinha posto sobre ele as suas mãos; assim os filhos de Israel lhe deram ouvidos, e fizeram como o SENHOR ordenara a Moisés.

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־ קָ֨ם נָבִ֥יא ע֛וֹד בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל כְּמֹשֶׁ֑ה אֲשֶׁר֙ יְדָע֣וֹ יְהוָ֔ה פָּנִ֖ים אֶל־ פָּנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- qām nā·ḇî ‘ō·wḏ bə·yiś·rā·’êl kə·mō·šeh ’ă·šer yə·ḏā·‘ōw Yah·weh pā·nîm ’el- pā·nîm
verses.literal: Since that time no prophet has risen in Israel like Moses whom the LORD knew face to face
verses.literalPt: E nunca mais se levantou em Israel profeta algum como Moisés, a quem o SENHOR conhecera face a face;

verses.original: לְכָל־ הָ֨אֹת֜וֹת וְהַמּוֹפְתִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר שְׁלָחוֹ֙ יְהוָ֔ה לַעֲשׂ֖וֹת בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם לְפַרְעֹ֥ה וּלְכָל־ עֲבָדָ֖יו וּלְכָל־ אַרְצֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ḵāl hā·’ō·ṯō·wṯ wə·ham·mō·wp̄·ṯîm ’ă·šer šə·lā·ḥōw Yah·weh la·‘ă·śō·wṯ bə·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim lə·p̄ar·‘ōh ū·lə·ḵāl- ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw ū·lə·ḵāl- ’ar·ṣōw
verses.literal: no prophet who did all the signs and wonders that the LORD sent Moses to do in the land of Egypt to Pharaoh and to all his officials and all his land
verses.literalPt: Nem semelhante em todos os sinais e maravilhas, que o SENHOR o enviou para fazer na terra do Egito, a Faraó, e a todos os seus servos, e a toda a sua terra.

verses.original: וּלְכֹל֙ הַיָּ֣ד הַחֲזָקָ֔ה וּלְכֹ֖ל הַמּוֹרָ֣א הַגָּד֑וֹל אֲשֶׁר֙ עָשָׂ֣ה מֹשֶׁ֔ה לְעֵינֵ֖י כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·ḵōl hay·yāḏ ha·ḥă·zā·qāh ū·lə·ḵōl ham·mō·w·rā hag·gā·ḏō·wl ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh mō·šeh lə·‘ê·nê kāl- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: and no prophet who performed all the mighty acts of power and awesome deeds . . . that Moses did in the sight of all Israel
verses.literalPt: E em toda a mão forte, e em todo o grande espanto, que praticou Moisés aos olhos de todo o Israel.
